name: Machine Triceps Extension
steps: Adjust the seat until your elbows align with the pivots and rest your upper arms against the pad.
Sit tall, brace your trunk and take the handles with your wrists straight.
Extend your elbows smoothly to push the handles forward and down until your arms are nearly straight, squeezing your triceps firmly.
Bend your elbows slowly back to the starting stretch without letting the weight stack bang.
tips: Keep your upper arms anchored on the pad rather than leaning your torso forward to push the handles.
Stop just short of snapping your elbows into hard lockout.
